policies.title: DR Congo ordinary passports: Eswatini advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Eswatini Home Affairs directly marks DRC as visa-required and routes ordinary holiday, tourist and business visitor applications through the Ministry or foreign missions before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Democratic Republic of the Congo passport holder travelling to Eswatini for a short holiday, tourist or business visit.
The standard application is handled by the Ministry of Home Affairs or an Eswatini foreign mission before travel.
The page's border-visa clause requires an undertaking that the visitor could not apply beforehand; that exceptional route is not a passport-wide visa-on-arrival baseline.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier checks and final border admission remain separate.

policies.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis ordinary passports: Nigeria reciprocal visa waiver
policies.summary: Saint Kitts and Nevis' government reports that its nationals receive reciprocal visa-free entry to Nigeria from 4 August 2025.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Saint Kitts and Nevis passport holder making a short visitor trip to Nigeria under the reciprocal waiver.
The official announcement does not state a maximum stay, so no duration is inferred.
Purpose restrictions, work, study, residence, special documents, health requirements, carrier checks and final immigration admission remain separate.
